title: 抽居屋
mood: a rehearsed sentence twelve years in the making
subject: a mother's fourth failed public housing ballot and the line she has practised
caption: Cantonese ballad arranged as a jazz piano trio and nothing more. Grand piano recorded close with the pedal and hammer noise audible, double bass played with fingers and allowed to decay fully, drum kit played entirely with brushes on the snare, one muted trumpet in the final section. Spacious and dry with very wide dynamics and no low-end reinforcement, the quiet passages genuinely quiet. Male voice, close and conversational, unpushed, no vibrato and no belting. 78 BPM, F major. A sentence rehearsed for twelve years. No synth, no strings section, no programmed drums, no chorus lift, no key change.
lyrics:
[Verse]
今朝六點 我阿媽已經換咗衫
佢話「唔使咁早」 但佢自己五點就起身
抽居屋 第四次 佢填咗十二年表格
每次佢都話「今次唔會中㗎啦」 然後每次都起得咁早

[Pre-Chorus]
個號碼喺電腦度跳
跳咗三秒 三秒好長

[Chorus]
冇中
阿媽即刻話「好啦 咁又慳返一筆」
佢講得好快 快過佢平時講嘢
我知 佢練過呢句

[Verse]
食晏嗰陣佢好正常 仲叫我食多啲餸
我洗碗嗰陣 聽到佢喺房入面同人講電話
佢同人講「唔緊要啦 下次囉」
佢講咗三次 「下次囉」

[Chorus]
冇中
阿媽即刻話「好啦 咁又慳返一筆」
佢講得好快 快過佢平時講嘢
我而家知 佢練咗十二年

[Outro]
下年嗰張表
佢已經放咗喺抽屜
